faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) for a project-based research position in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Indore?
faq.answer: IIT Indore has advertised for the position of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under a DST funded project in the Electrical Engineering department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or similar with 2 years of research/industry experience, or an M.E./M.Tech./M.S. in Electronics Engineering or similar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Indore SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for the Senior Research Fellow position, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What salary will be provided to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of INR 42,000/- per month along with 16% House Rent Allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore SRF position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply via email by sending their detailed CV and relevant supporting documents in a single PDF file to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this IIT Indore project job?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and qualifications, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application documents be emailed?
faq.answer: Applicants need to send their documents in a single PDF to [email protected] with the subject line specified as SRF recruitment.
